name: Exquisite Oil Painting
desc:
An oil painting in an ornate frame.
Its beauty enraptures viewers at a single glance.

name: Antique Vase
desc:
An antique-style vase.
It is said to be blessed with good fortune.

name: Ornamental Bird
desc:
An ornamental bird made from pure gold.
A rare decoration, it is thought to bring good luck.

name: Silver Recorder
desc:
An old recorder made of glistening material.
It fills the air with melancholy tones when played.

name: Vintage Perfume Bottle
desc:
A perfume bottle from a bygone era.
It holds faint traces of a pleasant scent that puts the mind at ease.

name: Wooden Tarot Cards
desc:
An old set of tarot cards made from wood.
While cracked here and there, their illustrations stand out in distinct relief.

name: Bronze Incense Burner
desc:
An old-fashioned incense burner.
Its mystical aura hints at its use in practices like divination and meditation.

name: Wealth Charm
desc:
A charm meant to bring wealth to the bearer.
Its brilliant shine seems to invite good fortune.

name: Antique Compass
desc:
A weathered compass.
Curiously, it still appears functional.

name: Ancient Pot
desc:
A pot used to store valuables.
It seems considerably old.
